story.storyContextArabic: تطلب القرية من ليث تنسيق مشروع الطريق إلى السوق.

lines.narrationArabic: تطلب القرية من ليث تنسيق مشروع الطريق إلى السوق.

lines.targetText: Dobbiamo parlare del progetto della strada.
lines.englishReference: We need to talk about the road project.
lines.arabicTranslation: نحتاج إلى الحديث عن the road project.
lines.pronunciation: Dobbiamo parlare del progetto della strada.

lines.targetText: Secondo me posso coordinare il progetto.
lines.englishReference: In my opinion, I can coordinate the project.
lines.arabicTranslation: في رأيي، I can coordinate the project.
lines.pronunciation: Secondo me posso coordinare il progetto.

lines.targetText: Perché conosco la squadra e le esigenze.
lines.englishReference: Because I know the team and the needs.
lines.arabicTranslation: لأن I know the team and the needs.
lines.pronunciation: Perché conosco la squadra e le esigenze.

lines.targetText: Suggerisco di iniziare con un sondaggio.
lines.englishReference: I suggest that we should begin with a survey.
lines.arabicTranslation: أقترح أن we should begin with a survey.
lines.pronunciation: Suggerisco di iniziare con un sondaggio.

lines.englishReference: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.

scenes.promptArabic: استعمل رأيًا وسببًا واقتراحًا في موقف عمل أو دراسة.

lines.targetText: L'incontro del villaggio ha sollevato domande utili.
lines.englishReference: The village meeting raised useful questions.
lines.pronunciation: L'incontro del villaggio ha sollevato domande utili.

lines.targetText: Alcune domande è meglio lasciarle per dopo.
lines.englishReference: Some questions are better left for later.
lines.arabicTranslation: بعض الأسئلة من الأفضل تركها لوقت لاحق.
lines.pronunciation: Alcune domande è meglio lasciarle per dopo.
